name: Velvet Antenna v0.22.3 Antenna Flow
author: James
description: Reliability-focused Antenna Flow release. v0.22.3 keeps Tonight, Continue the Story, One More Episode, Forgotten Signals, Rediscover, Signal Match and in-player CC+ subtitle search, while fixing hit-and-miss library behaviour: navigation now prefers Jellyfin's own router/native hrefs over guessed routes, stale v0.22.2 route caches are discarded, non-boxset Collections fall back to their real generic library route instead of forcing a broken #/boxsets page, and Movies/Series/Collections get a deterministic API-backed Velvet Lens stage even when Jellyfin cards have not rendered yet. TV navigation remains immediate and remote-first.
